text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review modeling study focused on the environmental impacts of dietary shifts in India using nationally representative dietary and environmental footprint data. The primary focus is on assessing changes in greenhouse gas emissions, water footprints, and land use associated with dietary scenarios, but it does not conduct spatially explicit land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. There is no implementation of spatial modeling with mapped LULC projections or quantitative accuracy metrics related to LULC. The study uses national averages and sub-national dietary groupings but does not present spatially explicit LULC future projections. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring primary focus on national-scale spatial LULC prediction with explicit mapped outputs.)
